text:
maria: Heads-up — mobile sampleapp streaming reconnects are occasionally delivering interleaved partial SSE chunks after the app is backgrounded. repro steps in thread.
sam: ugh, repro'd locally on Pixel 6. saw two events mashed into one data: payload.
alex: can you paste the raw HTTP body you saw? was it missing newlines or SSE delimiters?
maria: here, truncated log (sorry messy):

--- raw chunk start ---
data: {"id":1,"text":"hello"}
data: {"id":2,"text":"wo"
--- raw chunk end ---

then next chunk resumed: "rld"
so "world" got split and interleaved with previous event, client reassembly joined wrong pieces.
ben: that looks like the socket closed mid-frame, proxy concatenated tail of next write. which proxy path are you using? edge-proxy v1 or local dev proxy?
maria: edge-proxy in our staging cluster. mobile -> cloudflare -> edge-proxy -> redwood-host. interestingly browser sampleapp doesn't hit this.
sam: mobile backgrounding often pauses reads; OS might batch writes. if the proxy uses chunked buffering + a chunk boundary heuristic that assumes complete SSE lines per write, it'll break. we saw similar with http/1.1 chunk coalescing.
alex: SDK parity note: Go SDK's streaming client enforces a per-line parse and emits partial buffer on abort; JS SDK reassembles using lastEventId heuristics. we probably need parity: emit partial fragments so app can hold until next data line rather than merging.
maria: minimal patch idea: when a connection close is detected with an unterminated `data:` line, push a sentinel fragment which client treats as "incomplete" instead of concatenating. quick patch attached.
ben: can you paste the patch snippet? I'll open a PR if it looks sane.
maria: snippet:
```
- if line.startsWith("data:") {
-   buffer += line.slice(5)
- }
+ if line.startsWith("data:") {
+   if (line.endsWith(\"\n\") || line.endsWith(\"\r\n\")) {
+     buffer += line.slice(5)
+   } else {
+     // emit incomplete marker so client doesn't auto-join
+     emitIncomplete(buffer + line.slice(5))
+   }
+ }
```

sam: hmm, emitIncomplete is fine but will require SDKs to expose an option to auto-join fragments. otherwise mobile apps will see weird partial texts.
alex: agree. also we should consider sending a short heartbeat event every 10s to avoid long pauses being interpreted as EOF by proxies. lightweight: `event: ping
data: 

`.
ben: can we instead set `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` + ensure our proxy passes chunk boundaries? probably not reliable cross-cloud.
devx-bot: deploy-checklist: create small repro app, add e2e test that backgrounds the app for 15s then resumes, run against edge-proxy. (link: https://goto/repro-ticket/3245)
maria: thanks — I'll open a PR implementing the incomplete-fragment marker + add a mobile-sampleapp test. also adding heartbeat event as a fallback.
sam: sounds good. if PR touches runtime parsing, ping me for review — want to validate perf.
alex: I'll coordinate SDK parity changes (Go + JS + Python) so behavior is opt-in behind a flag initially.
ben: TY. filing an incident ticket to track customer reports and correlate logs: INC-2026-3245.
maria: posting repro app and logs to the ticket now :thumbsup:
